milestones.outcome: The Agent tab continues the real backend conversation and preserves the identities, workspace and lifecycle needed to resume it.
exit_criteria: Claude stream-json and qualified Codex conversations continue natively through the public Agent tab without closing a live connection after each answer.
Durable identity independent of window activation, retained workspace recovery, safe storage admission, stale revisions and Stop/uncertain-send fencing have direct functional evidence.
milestones.boundary: A usable native Agent-tab conversation; the shared session host is available for tour integration.

milestones.outcome: Each tour side chat has its own native session per agent, and both surfaces support New session with retained, reopenable history.
exit_criteria: Tour, Problem, Solution and stable-stop chats remain isolated by agent and resume through normal close/reopen cycles.
Nondestructive New session, reopening history and Reset tour/Undo reset preserve the defined BPR state and session associations without redirecting pending work or late completions.
milestones.boundary: Usable native conversations and scoped history in both requested product surfaces.

milestones.outcome: A continuing tour agent understands current BPR tour state and explains source warnings using the same reasons that drive the UI.
exit_criteria: Versioned tour guidance and coherent snapshots refresh all relevant facts, distinguish source confirmation from Ready/publication, and include actual blockers and available actions.
Text/order updates preserve confirmed anchors under the existing preparation rules; compaction/reconnect restores current context, and changed source state agrees in core, UI and agent context.
milestones.boundary: The reported warning/context problem has a distinguishing public-path course without inventing a reproduction of the owner's exact prior session.

milestones.outcome: Native continuity, legacy migration and explicit replay fallback are qualified and documented for the selected installed agents.
exit_criteria: Unsupported backends and unavailable or legacy native state offer explicitly identified replay generations or New session, without identity reassignment, permission bypass, silent downgrade or duplicate submission.
Installed Claude/Codex protocols, composed controls, crash/storage/idle boundaries, retained-context privacy, Release reuse/cost observations and operator disclosures have actual scoped evidence.
milestones.boundary: The proposed behavior is reviewable with honest runtime support and cost claims; unrelated native qualification is not inferred.

milestones.outcome: Every criterion of the adopted native-session RFC is judged against real evidence and the changed live contracts are reconciled.
exit_criteria: The closeout accounts for every RFC criterion, source amendment, focused public-path check and required documentation gate.
Any remaining required installed, platform or human evidence stays explicit rather than being replaced by authoring or fixture validation.
milestones.boundary: Acceptance of the authorized scope only, with the repository's preserved historical and release obligations.
